action: The blizzard builds and whirls faster and faster around the area, snow and ice chips lashing, then it slowly calms and the snow settles. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: BLIZZARD STORM: a swirling ground blizzard of driving snow, sleet and ice chips spinning in a wide horizontal ellipse seen from an elevated three-quarter view, frost forming on the ground, dark slate storm swirls at the edge, the centre empty. Palette: frost off-white, glacier blue, slate grey, pine green, muted aurora teal, leather brown, antique bronze. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Norse winter folk style: carved wood and stone, pine and birch, falcon feathers, fur and leather, bronze, physical snow and ice (not glowing crystal). NOT anime, no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no letters, no runes, no text, no Viking horned helmets, no valknut, no religious or political symbols, no wolves, no character, no person, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are frost off-white, never pure white.
